name: trapz
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::trapz.dx(Tensor y, *, float dx=1, int dim=-1) -> Tensor. FlagGems registers the same implementation for aten::trapezoid.dx, whose dx parameter is Scalar. The suite covers multiple ranks, dimensions and spacings, empty and length-one reductions, large reductions, noncontiguous input, integer promotion, fp64 spacing precision, dispatcher and direct FlagGems entry points, invalid dimensions and unsupported bool/complex inputs, and autograd. The reduction does not mutate or alias y.
